subject: Quick question on SaaS GTM Munich speaker slot
body:
Hi Julius,

Hope you’re doing well! Just checking in to confirm the details for your upcoming fireside chat at the Munich SaaS meetup. Could you please let me know if everything is set for your slot on the outbound-to-PLG transition topic?

Thanks a lot!

Best,
Lena

events.reply:
Hi Lena,

thanks for reaching out! Which meetup is this exactly, and what are the date, time and venue? Who invited me, and who is my contact on your side? I'm on the road a lot and want to match it against my calendar.

Best,
Julius

subject: Re: Quick question on SaaS GTM Munich speaker slot
body:
Hi Julius,

Great to hear from you! It’s the Munich SaaS meetup focusing on the fireside chat about the outbound-to-PLG transition. I don’t have the exact date and time right now, but I’ll get those details to you shortly. As for the invite, it came from our events team here at EventCrew-MUC. My colleague will be your main point of contact once we finalize all the logistics.

Looking forward to confirming everything soon.

Best,
Lena

events.reply: Hi Lena, thanks. Without a date, venue and the name of whoever invited me, I can't confirm anything. Please send me those details and your colleague's name, and I'll check my calendar. Best, Julius
